name: 凯里·索恩
introduction: Kerri Lee Romeo is an actor, director and screenwriter with a background in journalism, art curation, and improv comedy. She has written several screenplays, most recently Corporate Retreat, a horror-thriller about a group of corporate executives whose team-building retreat turns into a bloody fight for survival when their vengeful retreat leader turns on them. The film stars Rosanna Arquette, Ashton Sanders, and Odeya Rush, and is produced by Uri Singer, known for his work on White Noise and Tesla. Corporate Retreat was filmed in the summer of 2025 and is slated for release in 2026.As an actor, she's appeared in the Tribeca award-winning feature Nobody's Watching (MGM+), Inside the Rain (Showtime), and arthouse drama Little Deaths (Tubi). A member of Actor's Equity, she has performed in many Regional and Off-Broadway productions including the groundbreaking immersive show Sleep No More.
